# ---------------- dedup: first-write-wins on event_id (arrival order) ----------------
deduped = (raw.sort_values("arrival_order")
              .drop_duplicates(subset="event_id", keep="first")
              .sort_values("event_time")
              .reset_index(drop=True))

print(f"after dedup: {len(deduped)} events "
      f"(dropped {len(raw) - len(deduped)} replay of evt-001)\n")

# ---------------- event-time aggregation (ledger semantics) ----------------
deduped["event_minute"] = deduped["event_time"].dt.floor("min")

by_product = deduped.groupby("product_id")["revenue"].sum().sort_index()
by_minute  = deduped.groupby("event_minute")["revenue"].sum()

print("revenue by product:")
print(by_product.to_string(), "\n")

print("revenue by event-time minute:")
print(by_minute.to_string(), "\n")

print(f"granularity check: sum(by_product) = {by_product.sum()}, "
      f"sum(by_minute) = {by_minute.sum()}, "
      f"raw-total = {raw.revenue.sum()} (pre-dedup)\n")

# ---------------- the duplicate & the correction, made explicit ----------------
dup = raw[raw.event_id.duplicated(keep=False)]
print("duplicate group (shown as a multiset):")
print(dup[["arrival_order", "event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "event_time"]].to_string(index=False))

corr = deduped[deduped.revenue < 0]
print("\ncorrection event(s):")
print(corr[["event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "event_time"]].to_string(index=False))

print(f"\nexposure without the correction: {by_product['P1'] - corr.revenue.sum()}")
print(f"net P1 revenue with correction:   {by_product['P1']}")
